Hi Sophie / Mark — thanks for sending the initial details. A couple quick clarifications from the PDM side before our sync:

- Packaging: Two sensible options for Marketplace listing: (A) Managed SKU (Redwood-hosted listing with metered billing) or (B) BYOL with AMI. Managed SKU is easier for buyers and aligns well with co-sell economics; BYOL can work if Orbio has strict licensing constraints.
- Pricing: Please include a 12-month and a 36-month tier in the intake template. AWS tends to prefer annualized commitments for co-sell credits.
- Compliance: If SOC 2 status will be in play, include the certificate link and a short note on data residency for EU/US customers.

I'll confirm the proposed Feb 22 10:00 AM PT slot — sending a calendar invite now and adding the HubSpot deal RDW-2028-0807 to the invite.

Looking forward to the sync — we'll leave the first 10 minutes for intake review and the remainder to assign MAP owners.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Product Development Manager, Cloud Partnerships
Redwood Inference
